info.name: Couchbase Scopes and Collections API
info.description:
Operations tagged Scopes and Collections across 2 of this provider's published API definitions: couchbase-capella-management-api-openapi.yml, couchbase-server-rest-api-openapi.yml. Each path carries the servers of the definition it was published in.
